_comment: Single source of truth for contact details, socials, channel status and headline stats. js/site-config.js reads this and fills the header, footer and channel badges on every page.

business.name: Conversing AI
business.tagline: Websites and web apps, with AI chat agents that answer your customers 24/7
business.whatsappMessage: Hi Conversing AI, I'd like to talk about a website and an AI chat agent.

_todo_business: TODO(owner): phone, phoneDisplay, whatsapp (digits only, country code, no +), hours, location/registeredIn. Empty values are hidden automatically, so nothing breaks while they are blank.
_todo_social: TODO(owner): remaining profile URLs. Any left empty is hidden from the footer rather than linking to '#'.
_todo_channels: When a channel launches, change its value to 'live'. That single edit updates every badge, the pricing table row and the FAQ answer at once.

stats.label: running a live 24/7 AI chat agent

tryAsking: How much does a website cost?
Can you build an AI agent for my shop?
How long does a website take?
Do I own the code when it is finished?

_todo_chatAgent: TODO(owner): choose a provider (Voiceflow, Botpress, Chatbase, or a custom backend) and supply the embed details. While enabled is false the site shows an honest 'demo coming soon' card instead of a broken widget, and the Chat CTA falls back to the contact page.
_todo_booking: TODO(owner): Cal.com or Calendly link. While enabled is false, every 'Book a call' CTA falls back to the quote form.
_todo_analytics: TODO(owner): Meta Pixel ID if you intend to run Facebook ads. GA4 is already live.
_todo_guarantee: TODO(owner): decide the risk-reversal terms, for example 'unlimited design revisions until launch' or a 14-day agent trial. Hidden while enabled is false.
